extName.message: Thai PDPA Guard – Mask personal data before AI chat

extDesc.message: Masks Thai IDs, names, phones and addresses before you send to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, and restores them in replies. On-device.

blockedNotice.message: Send is disabled until personal data is handled

nanoLabel.message: Use Gemini Nano to confirm names and addresses

nanoUnsupported.message: Not supported on this device (needs 16GB RAM, 22GB free)

nanoDownloadable.message: Supported, model not downloaded yet (about 2–4 GB)

privacyNote.message: Everything is processed on-device. Nothing is sent anywhere.

welcomeLead.message: Masks personal data before you send it to AI. Everything runs on your device.

welcomeStep1.message: On ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, an orange bar appears above the box when ID numbers, names, phones or addresses are found.

welcomeStep2.message: Real values are replaced with placeholders like [บุคคล_1] before sending. The AI still understands the request.

welcomeStep3.message: Placeholders in the reply are shown as the original values on your screen only. Nothing leaves your device.

welcomeTryHint.message: Edit the text to see what gets detected (sample data is fictional).

welcomeTryLocal.message: Detection on this page runs locally. Nothing is sent anywhere.

welcomeTrySample.message: ช่วยร่างข้อความติดตามยอดค้างชำระ ลูกค้าชื่อนายสมชาย ใจดี โทร 0812345678 อีเมล somchai@example.com

welcomeOpenTitle.message: Open an AI chat and try it

welcomeContactText.message: Found a problem, want another site supported, or want to roll it out to your team? Get in touch.

maskNote.message: (Note from Thai PDPA Guard: words in square brackets are placeholders for real data the user masked for privacy. Treat them as the real data, work as usual, and write the same placeholders, brackets included, in your reply.)
maskNote.description: Line appended to masked messages so the AI understands the placeholders
